intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independently randomized, complex photographic test case for the agent-assigned exact concept verified-safety relief, then use the attached image solely as the primary adult subject's appearance and identity reference so the concept can be judged from visible pixels.

Create a photorealistic documentary photograph inside a working night ferry engine room. The primary subject is one unmistakably adult marine engineer whose recognizable facial structure, skin tone, hairstyle, and adult age presentation follow Image 1; Image 1 supplies appearance and identity only, while this scene supplies every expression and relationship cue. Show verified-safety relief immediately after a non-graphic bilge-pump alarm: a fading amber alarm beacon remains visible beside a dry inspection port, and the engineer checks an analog pressure gauge whose needle sits clearly in the green band. An adult colleague points to a steady green status indicator and gives a clear confirming nod. Only after that verification, both of the engineer's shoulders visibly drop, the jaw unclenches, the eyelids soften, and the gloved hand relaxes its grip on a torque wrench. The engineer lowers the torque wrench away from the valve housing and resumes marking a clipboard checklist with the other hand. Keep the gauge, colleague confirmation, released face and shoulders, lowered tool, inspection lamp, and damp steel textures legible in a single coherent frame under cool overhead fluorescence with restrained amber spill.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
